system.description: Starting at 14th Level, when a creature you can see within 30 feet of your Phantasm makes an attack. As a Reaction you can command the Phantasm to shift into the image of the target, confusing the attacking creature. The attacker must make a Wisdom save against your Genjutsu Save DC. On a Failed Save, the attacker must target the Phantasm.
